summary.result: It was found that there is a threshold spatial resolution between 4 m and 6.6 m to identify the full items.
summary.background: The satellite images were interpreted especially for identifying agricultural land use, crop types, agricultural facilities and structures of 18 items.
summary.method: Thus it is suggested that IKONOS fusion image (MS enhanced by PAN) is required to produce land use map for agricultural purpose.
